scope.services: Individual service checkboxes or toggles observed in existing inspected views. No extra Services-tab navigation; unavailable controls remain Not assessed.
scope.consent_record: Timestamped verified client-side semantic decision with state hash; no server-side audit adequacy claim.
scope.duration: Captured known CMP-cookie expiry with identity/value hash and timestamps; no future persistence or appropriateness claim.
scope.declared_not_found: Retained declaration-pattern overlap with usable pre-consent cookie snapshots; no stale-declaration or post-Accept absence claim.

historical: Stored v1 assessments retain their original labels and conclusions. New v2 materializations are source-hashed and persist through normalized concerns and concern policy.

cost.explanation: Downstream deterministic interpretation of existing retained evidence only; no scanner or capture budget change.

scoring: Informational checklist-only; no new score effects.
serviceTabInspection: Deferred after owner raised contention concerns; implementation removed before live verification.
